name: Chris Schmidt
bio:
Chris Schmidt, a master of black & gray, realism, and trash polka, brings a level of professionalism to the tattoo industry that is truly commendable. Clients consistently praise Chris for the meticulous attention to detail and the stringent hygiene standards maintained throughout each session. In a world where precision and cleanliness go hand-in-hand, Chris sets the bar incredibly high, ensuring every piece of art is not just visually stunning but also executed in the most sterile environment.
